data.name: Arcane Souls
data.detailed_description:
Enter Arcane Souls, an action soulslike RPG set in an era of deceptive peace. For generations, the Human Realm has existed in safety, allowing the legendary arts of war, powerful magic and cruel demons to become just a mere folklore. But as the ancient seal between dimensions begins to lose its powers, forgotten evil returns to a world that has forgotten how to bleed. You are a warrior in an age of comfort, forced to face a threat you were never meant to survive.

Key Features:

  • Explore The World Unprepared: Journey through a realm that has long enjoyed the luxury of peace, only to find itself on the brink of a dark awakening. Navigate vast landscapes and hidden ruins to uncover the truth behind the failing seals.

  • Conquer Forgotten Dungeons: Delve into the depths of catacombs and ancient strongholds that have remained silent for centuries. These dangerous vaults now crawl with horrors that demand a level of mastery long since lost to history.

  • Soulslike Combat: Face monsters in an era where warriors are at their weakest, every encounter is a test against powerful foes.

  • Reclaim the Arcane: In an age where magic has become a rarity and its power has dwindled, you must find new ways to wield it. Shape and create unique spells to bridge the power gap and stand a chance against the overwhelming might of the returning shadows.

  • Co-op: The coming storm is too vast for any individual. Group up with a friend in online co-op to face lethal challenges, defeat powerful bosses, and protect a world that is not ready to fight for itself.

  • Machine Learning-Enhanced AI: Experience a more sophisticated challenge with trained enemies. Some monsters feature adaptive combat behaviors, allowing them to react intelligently to player tactics with unpredictable and lethal efficiency.

data.short_description: Enter a fantasy world full of magic in this action soulslike RPG. Master deadly combat, shape your own unique spells, and face colossal bosses. Survive the unforgiving challenges alone, or spill blood alongside a friend in full online co-op.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1050 ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
